user.title: Set up Personality Engine
user.description:
Enable speaker-aware personality and per-device TTS routing for Home Assistant Assist.

After installation, configure speaker personalities in **Settings → Devices & Services → Personality Engine → Configure**.

add_user.title: Add speaker
add_user.description: Create a personality profile for a household member. The speaker ID must match the value sent by VoicePipeline (e.g. 'paul', 'cassandra').

configure_user.title: Configure personality
configure_user.description: Set the personality, LLM provider, and TTS voice for this speaker.

data_description.system_prompt: Injected before every conversation. Use {name} for the speaker's display name.
data_description.llm_api_base: Leave blank to use the provider default (e.g. http://localhost:11434 for Ollama).
data_description.llm_api_key: Required for Anthropic and OpenAI. Not logged.
data_description.fallback_provider: Used if the primary provider fails or times out.
data_description.tts_engine: Must match a configured TTS integration entity (e.g. tts.piper, tts.google_cloud).
data_description.tts_voice: Leave blank to use the engine default.

delete_user.title: Delete speaker
delete_user.description: Select a speaker profile to delete. The 'default' profile cannot be deleted.

abort.no_users: No speaker profiles found. Add a speaker first.
abort.no_deletable_users: No speakers to delete (the 'default' profile cannot be deleted).

error.invalid_speaker_id: Speaker ID may only contain lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores.
error.speaker_id_too_long: Speaker ID must be 50 characters or fewer.
